technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with stochastic bullish cross and supertrend support exist, but price remains below all major moving averages with bearish MACD and weak accumulation signals, creating a low-probability reversal setup without confirmed momentum.

fundamental.summary: XEL shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 42 days present timing risk with no fundamental catalysts evident.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (11/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional signal and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (406.4) with flat yield curve and imminent FOMC decision creates severe macro headwinds; utilities defensive positioning offers limited offset to systemic risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme RSI oversold (9-period) with stochastic bullish cross and supertrend support at 57.43 creates a classic mean-reversion setup in fear-driven market conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages with bearish MACD, negative CMF, no volume confirmation, and VIX crisis regime (406.4) with imminent FOMC decision creates systemic headwinds that overwhelm technical oversold signals.
